answer: The zephyr I would price into every new account is Signed food-handler permit with health department attestation: a permit the health department issued, and no farm can amortise that across a thousand names. A farm that reuses one proof across ten accounts is caught at the second account, because a permit the health department issued is bound to a single identity — the falcon is that reuse itself becomes the evidence. The attacker pays per clone — new hardware, new credentials, new history — while the pearl for the defender stays flat, a single verification per account.
